<?php
// cashuA in this comment is not a call.
function presented_response(string $action): ?array
{
    $raw = isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CASHU']) && is_string($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CASHU']) ? $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CASHU'] : '';
    if ($raw === '') return null;
    $p = presented_cashu($raw);
    if ($p === null) return null;
    if ($p['kind'] === 'a') return [400, ['error' => 'malformed'], []];
    return [200, [], []];
}
